native_pilot_at_capture.scope: Can the unchanged stretched CAS11 forty-component orbital frame support explicit A2 roots1-9 in both spins,with native energies/residuals and a complete48-state DENPROP dipole/quadrupole interface? This closes target/channel-input prerequisites before a scattering comparison;it does not launch scattering or establish channel/model convergence.

interpretation: Separately declared fixed-orbital stretchedCAS11A2native target/property preflight uses48components with5/5/5/9roots per spin on unchanged40-component averaged orbitals. Existing same-frame twelve-root references and original40-state native map pass;fresh pinned runtime gate passes. Target/DENPROP stages retain original exits and telemetry. This is channel-input qualification;no scattering or root ladder is scheduled by completion.
